quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the name for your arms and legs, all together. It is also the one that you stretch out wide when you do a jumping jack, but it is NOT your bones!
quests.question: Limbs
quests.hint: It is the name for your arms AND legs together!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Limbs are your arms and legs, working together as a team!
quests.funFact: Limbs is the special name for your arms and legs all together!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the name for the middle of your body, not counting your head, arms, or legs. It is also the one that includes your chest, tummy, and back all together, but it is NOT your back!
quests.question: Torso
quests.hint: It is the middle of your body!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Torso is the name for the middle of your body, made up of your chest, back, and tummy!
quests.funFact: Your torso is the name for your chest, tummy, and back all together!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found below your cheeks, holding your bottom teeth, not your ribs!
quests.question: Jaw
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It opens wide when you yawn.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Only your jawbone can move; the rest of your skull stays still.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that squeezes and pulls to help every part of you move. It is also the one found under your skin, all over your body, but it is NOT your bones!
quests.question: Muscles
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found under your skin.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: Muscles get stronger every time you run, climb, or play.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that grows slowly, a little bit every month, not your thighs!
quests.question: Toenails
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They help protect the tips of your toes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Keeping toenails trimmed helps your shoes feel comfortable.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to wiggle inside our socks. It is also the one you count when you play a counting game with your feet, but it is NOT your shins!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Hint: You use these to help you balance.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: You have ten toes, just like you have ten fingers!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that gives your head its round, bony shape. It is NOT your limbs!
quests.question: Skull
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the hard bone inside your head!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Skull is the hard bone inside your head that protects your brain!
quests.funFact: Your skull protects your brain the same way a helmet protects your head!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that grows a little longer every single week, not your hands!
quests.question: Fingernails
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They help protect the tips of your fingers.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: It takes about six months to grow one fingernail from base to tip.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that bends when you touch your toes, not your chest!
quests.question: Waist
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You spin a hula hoop around it.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: Your waist is where the top and bottom of your body meet.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the front of your leg, between your knee and your ankle. It is also the one that can feel very sore if you bump it on a table, but it is NOT your toes!
quests.question: Shins
quests.hint: Think about this: They are between your knee and your ankle, in front.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: Shins can feel extra sore because the bone sits close to your skin.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you use to blow up a balloon with one big breath. It is NOT your bones!
quests.question: Lungs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They fill with air when you breathe in!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Lungs fill up with air when you breathe and let you blow things up!
quests.funFact: Your lungs breathe in and out over twenty thousand times a day!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found in your chest, curving from your backbone to the front. It is NOT your hands!
quests.question: Ribs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They curve around your chest like a cage!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Ribs curve around your chest like a cage and protect your heart and lungs!
quests.funFact: Your ribs curve around your chest like a strong, protective cage!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that feels warm sand at the beach, not your shins!
quests.question: Soles
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They can feel very ticklish.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Walking barefoot on grass lets your soles feel every little tickle.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that closes gently every time you blink. It is also the one that shuts tight when you fall asleep at night, but it is NOT your hair!
quests.question: Eyelids
quests.hint: Think about this: They shut tight when you sleep.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Eyelids close on their own when you sleep, without you even trying.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a little round dot in the middle of your tummy. It is also the one that shows where you were once connected to your mother before you were born, but it is NOT your back!
quests.question: Belly Button
quests.hint: Think about this: It can be an innie or an outie.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Some belly buttons are innies, and some are outies.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you shake gently when you wave a magic wand. It is also the one found between your hand and your elbow, but it is NOT your fingernails!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: They are found where your hand meets your arm!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: Each of your wrists has eight tiny bones that help it bend!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms two little openings at the bottom of your nose. It is also the one that flares open wide when you breathe in deeply, but it is NOT your forehead!
quests.question: Nostrils
quests.hint: Think about this: Air goes in and out through these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: Nostrils help warm and clean the air before it reaches your lungs.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is shorter and thicker than your other fingers. It is also the one you hold up high to say 'great job' without saying a word, but it is NOT your knuckles!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: You point these up to say 'great job!'
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Your thumbs help your hands grip things tightly, like a cup or a pencil!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that tightens up when you stand on your tiptoes, not your kneecap!
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They tighten when you stand on tiptoes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Strong calves help you jump higher and run faster.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found between your shoulders and your tummy. It is also the one you pat gently when you feel proud of yourself, but it is NOT your throat!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: You can feel your heart beating right here!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: Your chest holds two very important helpers: your heart and your lungs!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the lowest part of your face. It is also the one that has a tiny dip in some people, called a dimple, but it is NOT your arms!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: It is at the very bottom of your face!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Humans are the only animals with a pointy chin like this!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that connects your head to your shoulders. It is also the one you turn to look left and right, but it is NOT your shoulder blade!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Hint: A scarf wraps around this part in winter.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck lets your head turn almost all the way around!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits on top of your neck. It is also the one that wears a hat when it is cold outside, but it is NOT your hair!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Hint: You shake it side to side to say no.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Your head holds your brain, which helps you think and dream!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to run fast in the park. It is also the one we use to jump high like a bunny, but it is NOT your knees!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Hint: You use these to kick a ball.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Your legs have the biggest, strongest bones in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we count on when we learn numbers. It is NOT your fingernails!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have five on each hand!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Your fingers can feel even the tiniest bump on a surface.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you look at in the mirror every morning -- but it is not your nostrils!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Your eyes, nose, and mouth are all part of it.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Smiling uses fewer muscles in your face than frowning.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that grows on top of your head. It is also the one we brush every morning to make it neat, but it is NOT your chin!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: Hint: It sits right on top, above your forehead.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Your hair grows about half an inch every month!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that pushes up high on your face when you smile -- but it is not your forehead!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: They puff up when you blow out birthday candles.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Babies often have extra round, chubby cheeks.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that holds up the straps of your backpack. It is NOT your tummy!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your backpack straps rest right on these!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: You use your shoulders every time you carry a backpack.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to wave hello and goodbye. It is NOT your fingernails!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, and you hug people with them!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Your arms can stretch out wide, like airplane wings.
